# Ginger

deceased

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P36](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0036), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Ginger is caged and possesses wicked golden eyes.

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P3](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0003)_

## Personality

Ginger is known for a suspicious nature and frequently greets others sarcastically, such as by calling them a "redheaded snippet." Additionally, Ginger possesses profane speech habits and is prone to terrible swearing that cannot be broken.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P10](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0010), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P38](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0038), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)_
